creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The same definitions get copied into board after board and drift apart. Eight of the maintainer's boards define the same `provenance` field by hand with different descriptions, and the `!type` pattern-hook script is repeated in many repos.

Starting sketch in `docs/design/work-across-boards.md`, section "Deferred": definitions live once on the owner's machine and are copied into each board that uses them, and the board's copy is what kan reads, so a collaborator without the owner's config still sees a complete board. Open: what happens when a board edits its copy, and whether `kan board create --from <board>` alone covers most of the need.
title: Design: definitions shared across boards (fields, columns, hooks)
